# Forensic Academy Africa

> Forensic Academy Africa delivers accredited, outcome-based forensic science and occupational certificate programs across NQF levels 5-8, empowering professionals in investigation, fraud examination, and compliance.

Based in Pretoria, South Africa, Forensic Academy Africa offers SAQA-registered and SASSETA/QCTO-accredited online and legacy learning programs in forensic science, forensic biology, project management, and fraud examination. The academy serves as an EISA Assessment Centre and is committed to POPIA-compliant data protection practices.

## Core Programs & Qualifications

- [Forensic Science: Empowering Investigations](https://www.forensicacademy.africa/fs-nqf5-online): National Certificate Forensic Science NQF 5 online program prospectus
- [Forensic DNA: From Incident Scene to Courtroom](https://www.forensicacademy.africa/fb-nqf6-online): National Certificate Forensic Biology NQF 6 DNA online program
- [Fraud Prevention, Detection & Investigation (NQF 8)](https://www.forensicacademy.africa/ocfe-nqf8-online): Occupational Certificate Fraud Examiner NQF 8 online program
- [Fraud Examiner: Managing Risk and Investigation (NQF 7)](https://www.forensicacademy.africa/aodfe-nqf7-online): Advanced Occupational Diploma Fraud Examiner NQF 7 online program
- [Outcome-Based Learning](https://www.forensicacademy.africa/legacy-learning): Legacy learning programs for NQF 5-6 forensic science and biology
- [Collective Competence](https://www.forensicacademy.africa/occupational-learning): Occupational certificates in project management, compliance and fraud

## Occupational Certificates

- [Compliance Officer: Compliance Intelligence and Governance (NQF 6)](https://www.forensicacademy.africa/occo-nqf-6-online): Occupational Certificate Compliance Officer NQF 6 governance program
- [Project Manager (NQF 5)](https://www.forensicacademy.africa/ocpm-nqf-5-online): Occupational Certificate Project Manager NQF 5 online program
- [Office Administrator (NQF 5)](https://www.forensicacademy.africa/ocoa-nqf-5-online): Occupational Certificate Office Administrator NQF 5 online program
